dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Hi, you two! It's been a while, hasn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, you're back! Wait... That must mean there's a new exam!

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Yep. It's time for the Advanced exam. This one will be harder than previous exams, but I'm sure you'll do just fine.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I'm sure you have nothing to worry about. I actually had Mr. Albedo take a look at your previous potions. He was a bit amazed that someone so new to potion-making could already produce such an impressive result.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: He even told me that, for someone of your talent, we could stand to set harder questions.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, the recognition feels nice and all... But, Paimon feels even more pressure now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If we don't pass this time, it'll be super embarrassing!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Don't worry too much about that. Lots of things in life require a couple of tries before you get it right.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: When I first started working as Mr. Albedo's assistant, all sorts of unexpected things would go wrong during my experiments...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: For example, when I was studying the properties of Mist Flowers, I accidentally froze all the equipment in the lab. I basically turned them into ice sculptures. Our precision instruments were nearly ruined beyond repair.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Another time, I let a reagent boil for a little bit too long, and all the precious ingredients inside got charred to pieces. The smell was so bad, several knights passing by thought the lab had caught on fire...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Back then, I would get really hard on myself whenever things went wrong, but eventually I realized that, in order to make new discoveries, you have to accept the risk of failure.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: A fear of making mistakes will prevent you from truly going after what it is that you want.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're absolutely right! Hey, you're actually really good at motivating people!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Hehe, it's just my experience talking — I've spent a lot of time doing research in the lab after all. Anyway, as long as you try, you'll learn something valuable from the experience.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Alright, whenever you're ready, we can go ahead and proceed with the Advanced exam.

choices.text: Not yet, I need a little more time.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: No problem, I'll be waiting for you here.
